title: Bump federated pins: opum-lore and opum-quest to v0.6.0
summary: opum-agent flagged: lore-cli and quest-cli published 0.6.0 (verified directly against the npm registry -- all 14 packages live, both repos' main==dev==v0.6.0 annotated tags, 426-row qualification plus an 18/18 post-publish registry smoke pass), and this repo's marketplace.json still pins both federated entries at v0.5.0. Not blocked by OMARK-21's observation hold -- see this task's own notes for why -- so proceeds now rather than waiting for 2026-09-15. Same mechanical pattern as OMARK-20's 0.4.x -> 0.5.0 bump: update the two ref strings, let scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs's live fetch confirm each tag's own plugin.json declares the matching version, land via the normal dev branch/PR path.

acceptanceCriteria.text: State explicitly why this is NOT covered by OMARK-21's hold, since opum-agent asked directly rather than assuming: OMARK-21's freeze, read from its own summary, is scoped to observing opum-workflow 0.4.0's hook behavior specifically (OMARK-10/OPAG-62's idle-relay fix, OMARK-18/OPAG-63's no-direct-commit skill amendment) -- properties of opum-workflow's own content. opum-lore/opum-quest are federated pins to OTHER repos' release tags, unrelated content, and this repo's own opum-workflow version/build stays untouched by bumping them -- no risk of observing a different opum-workflow build than the one under observation.

Both marketplace.json entries move to v0.6.0, verified against the live federated pin checker (network fetch of each tag's own plugin.json, confirming its declared version matches the pin) before landing, not just shape-checked.

Land via the normal dev branch/PR path; no CHANGELOG entry needed since this does not touch opum-workflow's own shipped content (skills/hooks/agents/commands/plugin.json) -- confirm the diff scope check . manifests uses stays empty, same as OMARK-32's federated-pin-adjacent change.

implementationNotes: scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs run for real (live network fetch, not the fixture-server regression test): 'federated pins OK (3 plugin(s) checked)' -- confirms both lore-cli@v0.6.0 and quest-cli@v0.6.0 tags exist and each tag's own plugin.json declares '0.6.0', matching the pin. Manifests shape check and 46/46 hook tests also clean. Diff scope against skills/hooks/agents/commands/plugin.json empty, confirming no CHANGELOG entry needed.
finalSummary: opum-lore and opum-quest both bumped to v0.6.0, verified live against the registry-published tags before landing. Not covered by OMARK-21's hold, per this task's own AC1 reasoning.
